name: com.dominicbytes.game-accessibility
description: Sample implementation of the game-accessibility skill: a registry-backed accessibility settings store with presets, OS-preference import and versioned persistence, plus AssistPolicy, InputAssist, FlashGuard, CaptionBus and ColorTokens in plain C#, and small Unity adapters (bootstrap, camera comfort, guidance channels, content variants, captions, audio mixer binding, narration routing). Not compiled in the source repository; see GUIDE.md.
